title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Hard Rock Live, Hollywood | 2012
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Hard Rock Live, situated at the Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood in Hollywood, Florida, USA, on 30 June 2012.

It was the 13th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 26 dates in June and July 2012.

Starr previously performed at the Hard Rock Live on 3 July 2008 and 15 July 2010. He returned there on 17 September 2022 and 20 June 2025. Paul McCartney also performed at the venue on 25 May 2022.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
